Executive Administration Tools

Governance & Controls
Clinic Backup (JSON)

Download complete snapshot of patients, logs, accounts, and system configuration for offline recovery.

Export Registry (CSV)

Export formatted Excel/Sheets compatible roster with demographics, contact, doctors, sessions, dues & totals.

Financial Reconcile

Force recompute all patient ledger balances, flush offline queues, and verify cloud sheet consistency.

User Accounts & Roles

Manage clinicians, staff logins, branch permissions, and set secure 6-digit mPINs.

Audit Trail & Activity

Review staff logins, session entries, bill issuances, and security-sensitive clinic actions.

Bulk Dues Reminders

Instantly review all patients with pending balances and dispatch WhatsApp or SMS payment links.

Automated Feature Test Suite

Run live assertions verifying Role Dashboards, EMR Red Flags, PHC Conveyance Math, Modalities/VAS Parser, Package Auto-Exhaustion, and FIFO Dues.
